p030.lead: The Paradise classification by origin, the Uversa Personality Register, and the seven stages an ascending mortal passes through from planet to Paradise.

p030.foot.text: Sponsored by a Mighty Messenger from Uversa

p030.s0.h: Introduction — A Map That Is Shown but Not Fully Drawn
p030.s0.b0: Paper 30 serves as a kind of index that gathers up the superuniverse series. The beings who function in Paradise and the grand universe are so numerous that even their major orders would bewilder human imagination. The author announces that he will present two classifications: a suggestion of the Paradise classification and an abridgment of the Uversa Personality Register.
p030.s0.b1: What is striking is that this classification is incomplete on purpose. Because not all groups are revealed, no fully consistent classification is possible, and completing it would take many more papers. Yet the author says this would not be desirable, since it would deprive thinking mortals of the next thousand years of the stimulus to creative speculation.

p030.s0.b2.q: It is best that man not have an overrevelation; it stifles imagination.

p030.s0.b3: This principle also tells us how to read the paper. Rather than memorizing long lists of names, it is more important to accept that the universe is orderly in its organization and yet holds wide margins we cannot yet fully know.
p030.s1.h: I. The Paradise Classification of Living Beings — By Origin
p030.s1.b0: On Paradise, living beings are classified by their inherent and attained relationship to the Paradise Deities. At the great gatherings, too, those present are often grouped by origin: triune, dual, and single origin. Add the eventuated beings, the fragments, the superpersonal beings, and others, and there are seven categories.

p030.s1.b2: Looking for our own place in this classification is astonishing. Adjuster-fused mortals, together with Son-fused and Spirit-fused mortals, are listed among the ascending orders of dual-origin beings. A being who began in animal origin, united with a fragment of God, enters so high a category. The paper sums up God’s ways of working in three words.

p030.s1.b3.q: God, as a superperson, eventuates; God, as a person, creates; God, as a preperson, fragments

p030.s1.b4: That fragment, the Adjuster, evolves the spirit soul upon the material mind in accordance with the freewill choices of the personality that the Father has bestowed on the mortal. A clear principle about personality is also stated: there are no personalities of “pure mind,” and no mind entity that is not associated with spiritual or physical energy is a personality.

p030.s1.b5.q: no entity has personality unless he is endowed with it by God who is spirit.

p030.s1.b6: The author confesses that these papers cannot even begin to exhaust the story of the beings who live, worship, and serve in the universes of time and the central universe of eternity. Mortals are persons, so personalized beings can be described to us, but an absonitized being could never be explained. Passages like this, in which a revelation states its own limits, lead us to hold humbly what we know and keep an open mind before what we do not.

The chief purpose of the list is to present the beings revealed in these narratives, especially the orders mortals will meet on their way to Paradise. The vast hosts who work apart from mortal ascension are not mentioned.

p030.s3.h: III. The Courtesy Colonies — Guests Who Learn and Teach
p030.s3.b0: The seven courtesy colonies are groups of guests who sojourn for longer or shorter periods on the architectural spheres. The star students choose worlds well suited to observation, such as Uversa, and any being from any world who has sufficient knowledge of continuing life and physical law may join this corps of celestial astronomers. Once enrolled, however, one may not withdraw for a millennium of Uversa time.

p030.s3.b1.q: Except on Paradise, knowledge is not inherent

p030.s3.b2: This statement—that understanding of the physical universe largely depends on observation and research—affirms the value of scientific inquiry on a cosmic scale. The passage about the extension-school instructors reveals a feature of the entire ascension plan: the practice of giving new truth and experience to others as soon as it is acquired.

p030.s3.b3.q: You work your way through the long school of Paradise attainment by serving as teachers to those pupils just behind you in the scale of progression.

p030.s3.b4: The colony of student visitors on Uversa alone now numbers over one billion individuals. Morontia mortals may be visitors only within their own local universe, yet the human desire to travel and see new peoples and worlds, the paper says, will be fully gratified on the way to Paradise. The wish to travel and learn is no idle curiosity; it is part of the ascending career.

p030.s3.b5.q: The privilege of intrauniverse travel and observation is a part of the career of all ascending beings.

p030.s4.h: IV. The Ascending Mortals — Seven Stages from Planet to Paradise
p030.s4.b0: The last section of the paper is our own story. The author surveys the universe career of Adjuster-indwelt mortals in seven stages, explaining that he tells it in these terms because all the races of Urantia may look forward to this destiny.

p030.s4.b2: The account of the sleeping survivors eases our fear about what follows death. The passing of time means nothing to those who sleep, and apart from the time delay they move through the ascension regime exactly like everyone else.

p030.s4.b3.q: those who have slept five thousand years will react no differently than those who have rested five days.

p030.s4.b4: Resurrection is not the reassembly of the physical body. The Adjuster keeps the spirit transcript of the mind and the seraphim keeps the evolved soul, and when the two reunite their trusts, the new individual constitutes the survival of the old personality. The paper explains that the “mansions” of the Father’s house of which Jesus spoke refer to these training worlds.

p030.s4.b5.q: The mind, personality, and character are unchanged by such an advance; only does the form undergo modification.

p030.s4.b6: After the spirit confirmation received before leaving the local universe, the ascender’s status is settled forever. In the superuniverse the ascender masters local and superuniverse administration; the journey to Havona is always made alone; and the first act on arrival is to thank the transport seconaphim who carried him there. A new career that begins with gratitude is a memorable picture.

p030.s4.b7.q: Superuniverse wards have never been known to go astray.

p030.s4.b8: This journey is also one in which the form changes at every stage. On earth we were creatures of flesh and blood, in the local universe morontia beings, and in the superuniverse evolving spirits. Only on reaching Havona does spiritual education begin in earnest, until at last we appear on Paradise as perfected spirits. It is also worth noting that the path walked in classes is replaced in Havona by personal and individual training.
p030.s5.b0: Paper 30 hides a story within its long lists. In the midst of an almost endless order of beings lies the path of the mortal who begins in animal origin and advances to Paradise. Even if the Mortal Corps of the Finality had no further destiny, the author says, its present assignment would be fully adequate and glorious.

p030.s5.b1.q: Their present destiny wholly justifies the universal plan of evolutionary ascent.

p030.s5.b3: Paper 31, the last of this series, describes in detail the Mortal Corps of the Finality, named in this paper as the goal of the ascent.
p031.lead: The Corps of the Finality, the present destination of ascending mortals, and the ultimate adventure toward the universes of outer space: the paper that closes Part I.

p031.foot.text: Jointly sponsored by a Divine Counselor and One without Name and Number authorized so to function by the Ancients of Days on Uversa

p031.s0.h: Introduction — The Corps That Awaits at the End of the Ascent
p031.s0.b0: Paper 30 traced the seven stages from planet to Paradise; Paper 31 describes the **Mortal Corps of the Finality**, which the ascender enters at the end of that journey. This corps is the present known destination of the Adjuster-fused mortals of time, yet it is not a body of mortals alone. Six groups make up this unique association.

p031.s0.b2: All who are admitted to the corps are received as equals, but that equality never removes individuality or personal identity. In communicating with a finaliter, we are told, one can at once discern whether he is an ascendant mortal or a seraphim. That oneness does not mean sameness is a principle that applies to every relationship that forms a community.

p031.s0.b3.q: this exalted equality in no way abrogates individuality or destroys personal identity.

p031.s0.b4: The finaliters now return to serve in the universes of time, and only after working in all six other superuniverses are they assigned to their native superuniverse; in this way they gain a sevenfold concept of the Supreme Being. At least one company is always serving on Urantia. They are a self-governing body that chooses its own leaders, and their oath of allegiance is given only to the Paradise Trinity.

p031.s0.b5.q: They are indeed the accumulating tried and true souls of time and space—the evolutionary salt of the universe—and they are forever proof against evil and secure against sin.

p031.s1.h: I–II. The Havona Natives and the Gravity Messengers — The Perfect and the Perfected
p031.s1.b0: Many Havona natives who teach the pilgrims become so attached to ascending mortals that millions upon millions of them are now on the waiting list. They are perfect beings of direct and divine creation, yet they must achieve a certain experiential development alongside evolutionary beings before they can receive a fragment of the Father’s spirit.

p031.s1.b1.q: The finaliters thus embrace both phases of experiential existence—perfect and perfected.

p031.s1.b2: The Gravity Messengers are modified and personalized Adjusters from Divinington, superspirit beings who seem to make use of all energies and circuits, even gravity. Mortal finaliters cannot defy time and space, but these beings, who can, are under their command. Because both are deeply related to fragments of the Father, they hold a profound affection for each other.

p031.s1.b4: Finaliters are mobilized by companies, but the oath of finality is always taken individually. They work together, yet each makes the eternal decision alone.
p031.s2.h: III. Glorified Mortals — One Stage Still to Come
p031.s2.b0: Even the beings of Uversa do not know the “finality destiny” of ascending mortals. They believe, however, that so long a training must be meant to prepare them for greater trust and responsibility. A telling fact is offered in support: finaliters are recorded only as spirits of the sixth stage.

p031.s2.b2: The mortal finaliters have fully obeyed the command “⟦Q 31:3.6⟧Be you perfect⟦/Q⟧,” but the paper carefully distinguishes their achievement in three ways. They have reached the present limit of spirit progression, creature perfection, and Deity worship, but not the finality of ultimate status, service, and experiential Deity attainment. This distinction—that completion is not the end—offers a humble view of growth.

p031.s2.b3.q: They have achieved the present limit of creature perfection but not finality of creature service.

p031.s2.b4: The author says that human beings are entitled to share in speculating about this mystery, and compares the present assignments to postgraduate courses in universe administration. Then he leaves us with a question.

p031.s2.b5.q: “Why should the Gods be so concerned in so thoroughly training surviving mortals in the technique of universe management?”

p031.s3.h: IV–VII. Companions in the Ascent and the Vacant Place
p031.s3.b0: Many faithful seraphic guardians pass through the ascending career with their mortal subjects, and after the mortal’s Father fusion they take the finaliter oath together, accepting the mortal’s destiny forever. The angel who guarded us on earth may become a companion to the very end.
p031.s3.b1: Material Sons also enter this path: Adamic citizens whose planetary assignment is long delayed may ascend by petition, and planetary Adams and Eves may choose to ascend in the later ages of light and life. Those who default in their mission, like Urantia’s Adam, take the same natural course as their people—receiving Adjusters, passing through death, and ascending by faith. It is moving that the way stays open even after failure. Midway creatures likewise begin their ascent once their native world is settled in light and life, and all secondary midwayers eventually fuse with Adjusters.
p031.s3.b2: At present every company has 999 permanent members, and the one vacancy is filled by the chief of a temporary group, the Evangels of Light. There are also only six classes of permanent members for now. Even the authors on Uversa differ about who the seventh group will be; they expect it will be known only when the finaliters enter the seventh stage of spirit attainment.
p031.s4.h: VIII–IX. The Transcendentalers and the Architects of the Master Universe — Neither Creators nor Creatures
p031.s4.b0: On Paradise the finaliter seeks to understand the Transcendentalers, more than a thousand groups of absonite beings who neither create nor are created but simply eventuate. They live in the western area of Paradise and have nothing to do with the affairs of Havona or the superuniverses; they are concerned only with the superadministration of the master universe. Man’s first serious contact with them comes when he takes the finaliter oath, which is administered by the chief of the Transcendentalers.

p031.s4.b1.q: These Transcendentalers create no beings, neither were they ever created.

p031.s4.b2: The Architects of the Master Universe are the governing corps of the Transcendentalers, numbering 28,011 personalities in all. The mandate for these narratives forbids fully revealing their origin, nature, and destiny, though their existence may be disclosed. We are told, however, that they exist on seven levels of the absonite.

p031.s5.h: X. The Ultimate Adventure — Toward the Outer Universes
p031.s5.b0: The senior Master Architect oversees the seven Corps of the Finality, whose heads form the Supreme Council of Destiny; in this age it is presided over by Grandfanda, the first mortal ascender. The mobilization of these seven corps is the first such event since the near-eternal days when the superuniverse rulers were commissioned, and it is understood as the grand universe’s response to the future needs of the outer universes.
p031.s5.b1: The outer universes will come into being lacking one thing: the experience of taking part in the evolution of the Supreme Being. We now face difficulties because the sovereignty of God the Supreme is incompletely actualized, yet for that very reason we share in the experience of his evolution. The paradox is that our present imperfection is a privilege that will not come again.

p031.s5.b2.q: We evolve in him and he evolves in us.

p031.s5.b3.q: These deficiencies are inevitable on all levels of universe existence.

p031.s5.b4: So the authors conjecture that the Corps of the Finality may be destined to administer the outer universes, compensating for their experiential deficiency, just as higher spiritual beings now come down to minister to the mortals of the evolutionary universes. At the same time they honestly state that of only three things are they certain.

p031.s5.b6.q: What a glorious destiny for the animal-origin children of time, the material sons of space!

A local universe is the handiwork of a Creator Son of the Michael order, and it is organized into one hundred constellations, each with one hundred systems, each system eventually holding about one thousand inhabited spheres.

p032.s0.b2: The key word of this paper is **evolution**. All the universes of time and space are evolutionary, and the creative plan of the Michaels follows the path of gradual development of the physical, intellectual, and spiritual capacities of their creatures. The sovereign of our universe is Jesus of Nazareth, Michael of Salvington, and all his plans were approved by the Paradise Trinity before he began his adventure.

p032.s0.b3.q: These universes of time and space are all evolutionary.

p032.s1.h: I. Physical Emergence of Universes — Those Who Come Before the Creator Son
p032.s1.b0: A local universe does not begin on the day its Creator Son arrives. Prior to universe existence, space-force is handled by the Paradise force organizers, and once energy responds to local or linear gravity, the superuniverse power directors take over. Until the power directors have assembled enough energy to form suns and material spheres, a Creator Son has no opportunity to begin organizing.

p032.s1.b2: Local universes are roughly equal in energy potential, though they may differ in size and in the amount of visible matter. The energy charge of a local universe is about one one-hundred-thousandth of its superuniverse, and Nebadon has somewhat less mass materialization. Even so, Nebadon possesses every physical endowment found in any local creation of Orvonton.
p032.s2.h: II. Universe Organization — From Salvington to Satania
p032.s2.b0: The Creator Son materializes visible matter from the energy organized in advance, designs living creatures, and in co-operation with the universe presence of the Infinite Spirit creates spirit personalities. The power directors who first put the energy into circuits thereafter share its control with the Son forever, and the very same one hundred power centers who co-operated in forming Nebadon still work at Salvington.
p032.s2.b1: The first physical creation completed in Nebadon was the headquarters world, Salvington, with its satellites. A little more than one billion years passed between the first movements of the power centers and the arrival of the living staff on Salvington. Then one hundred constellation headquarters and ten thousand system headquarters were created, architectural worlds designed to accommodate even the morontia stage between physical and spiritual beings.

p032.s2.b3: What stands out in this order is that man comes last. Only after the house is built and those who will govern and care for its inhabitants are all in place are mortals created. When we came into this world, an order was already prepared to receive us.
p032.s2.b4: Nebadon is still a young universe in Orvonton, and its planetary organization continues. At the last registry there were 3,840,101 inhabited planets. The 619 inhabited worlds of our system, Satania, are scattered among more than five hundred physical systems; Satania lies on the fringe of our local universe, and Nebadon itself lies toward the outskirts of Orvonton.

p032.s2.b5.q: you can adequately comprehend the destiny of the mortals of such a local creation only by a perusal of the narratives of the life and teachings of your Creator Son as he once lived the life of man, in the likeness of mortal flesh, on your own evolutionary world.

p032.s3.h: III. The Evolutionary Idea — Perfection Is Something Attained
p032.s3.b0: The only perfectly settled creation is the central universe of Havona. All other universes are finite and evolutionary, and they will not be settled in light and life until their physical possibilities are exhausted and the spiritual status of every inhabited world is settled. Havona holds the pattern of perfection, and every other realm must attain that perfection by its own established methods.

p032.s3.b2: There is a wise compensation in this contrast. To the mortal in a distant universe who cannot see the Father in person, the Father is closest of all as the Adjuster within the mind. Yet the farther down the scale of life we go, the harder it becomes to find the invisible Father by faith, and some grow weary, doubt, and isolate themselves. The paper names the surest safeguard in that season: holding tenaciously to the truth of the Father’s presence in his Sons.

p032.s3.b3.q: He who has seen a Creator Son has seen the Father.

p032.s3.b4: An evolutionary beginning is no stain. Animal origin is the exclusive method of producing one of the two basic types of finite intelligent will creatures, and those who climb from the very bottom, step by step, come to know every phase of life by experience. The perfection so attained, though grace is lavishly mingled with it, is in the end a genuine personal possession that comes from individual effort and actual living.

p032.s3.b5.q: all the more honor to those who began at the bottom and joyfully climbed the ladder of life, round by round

p032.s3.b6: The Father could have made every mortal perfect by a single word. But that would have deprived them of the adventure and training of the long inward journey. p032.s4.h: IV. God’s Relation to a Local Universe — A Father Who Steps Back yet Takes Part
p032.s4.b0: Because the Father has delegated so much power, he appears to be the least active of the Deities. But the paper warns us not to mistake him for a silent member. The Father refrains only from what someone else can do. He steps back because he knows his creatures need function and experience, yet through designated agencies and personalities he actually and personally takes part in events.

p032.s4.b2: The Adjuster is a relatively isolated being, not directly co-ordinated with the local universe administration or with seraphic ministry. Yet it is through this separate channel that the invisible God reveals his presence to each person. And by means of the personality circuit, the Father personally knows the thoughts and acts of every being in all creation.
p032.s4.b4: The section ends on the Father’s generosity. God is not a self-centered personality; he has divested himself of every function that another being can perform. And whatever he has kept, from that he gives Adjusters to mortals. The climax of the section is the confession that he has given himself to us so that we may become like him.

p032.s4.b5.q: God has given us himself that we may be like him

p032.s5.h: V. The Eternal and Divine Purpose — Eternity Drawn as a Circle
p032.s5.b0: The last section declares that there is a great and glorious purpose in the march of the universes. We are part of a plan too vast to see in a single lifetime, and the events of time and our material struggles are temporary scaffolding for crossing over into the promised land of spiritual reality.

p032.s5.b1.q: All of your mortal struggling is not in vain.

p032.s5.b2: The author suggests that we think of eternity not as a straight line but as a cycle, an endless circle. Segments of time are born, live, and die, but they reappear in new form in the higher life that moves around the eternal circle. For most human beings who do not attain Adjuster fusion in the flesh, death is the way to escape the fetters of time and fall into step with the procession of eternity. The author frankly admits that he too cannot fully visualize eternity.

p032.s5.b3.q: The race for perfection is on!

p032.s6.b0: Paper 32 confirms again and again that the universe is not handed over finished all at once. Energy gathers first, the house is built, those who will govern take their places, and then man comes. And man too is not a finished product but a being who starts at the bottom and gains perfection through experience. The Father seems to stand back from this process, yet in fact he works most closely of all, in his Sons and in the Adjuster within our minds.

p032.s6.b2: Paper 33 describes in more detail the administration of the local universe introduced here: Michael, the Creative Spirit, and the government of Salvington. Keeping in mind the order of growth sketched in this paper will make it easy to follow at what stage, and why, the many beings of the following papers appear.
p033.lead: The joint rule of Michael and the Mother Spirit, Gabriel and Immanuel, courts and assemblies: how Nebadon is actually governed.

p033.foot.text: Presented by the Chief of the Archangels of Nebadon

p033.s0.h: Introduction — The Father Rules Through the Son
p033.s0.b0: If Paper 32 described how a local universe grows, Paper 33 shows how such a universe is run once it has grown. The Universal Father most certainly rules over his vast creation, but in the administration of a local universe he works only through the person of the Creator Son. The Son forms and executes the plans and policies, and together with his Spirit associate he delegates executive power to Gabriel and jurisdictional authority to the Constellation Fathers, System Sovereigns, and Planetary Princes.

p033.s1.h: I. Michael of Nebadon — The One Who Is God to Us
p033.s1.b0: Our Creator Son is the personification of the 611,121st original concept of infinite identity of simultaneous origin in the Universal Father and the Eternal Son. His headquarters is the threefold mansion of light on Salvington, so ordered because he has lived all three phases of creature existence: spiritual, morontial, and material. Because of his seventh and final bestowal on Urantia, he is sometimes called Christ Michael.
p033.s1.b1: Michael is not the Eternal Son, nor is he a member of the Paradise Trinity. Yet in his realm he possesses all the divine attributes and powers the Eternal Son would show were he present on Salvington, and beyond that he represents the personality presence of the Universal Father in this universe. That is why he is the most powerful and versatile of all divine beings who can deal directly with the immature creatures of an evolutionary universe.

p033.s1.b2.q: To our universe and all its inhabited worlds the Sovereign Son is, to all practical intents and purposes, God.

p033.s1.b3: This sentence brings real comfort to the life of faith. We can never fully grasp infinite Deity, but all of divinity that evolving mortals can discerningly comprehend is personified in this Son. A ruler and parent as mighty and beneficent as the Father and the Son would be if both were present on Salvington is already near us.
p033.s2.h: II. The Sovereign of Nebadon — Sovereignty Earned by Bestowal
p033.s2.b0: Some Creator Sons resemble more the Father, some the Son; our Michael resembles more the Eternal Son. His power is limited only by the pre-existent gravity circuits centering at Paradise and by the Ancients of Days’ reservation of final judgments on the extinction of personality. Personality is the sole bestowal of the Father, but with the approval of the Eternal Son a Creator Son may initiate new creature designs.
p033.s2.b1: The decisive turning point was the Urantia bestowal. When Michael returned from his final bestowal, the Creative Mother Spirit subordinated herself to him, and he thereby acquired jurisdiction over “⟦Q 33:2.3⟧all power in heaven and on earth.⟦/Q⟧” His experience of living as a creature qualifies him to portray the experiential divinity of the Supreme Being, and no other being holds such qualifications for solitary sovereignty.

p033.s2.b2.q: No other beings in the universes have thus personally exhausted the potentials of present finite experience

p033.s2.b3: Being sovereign does not mean staying at court. Michael spends much of his time visiting constellation and system headquarters and even individual planets, and he journeys to Paradise and often to Uversa. While he is away, Gabriel takes his place as regent.
p033.s3.h: III. The Universe Son and Spirit — Like a Father and a Mother
p033.s3.b0: The Universe Mother Spirit of Salvington belongs to the sixth group of Supreme Spirits and is the 611,121st of that order; she volunteered to accompany Michael when he left Paradise. The Son is the personal sovereign of the universe, but the Spirit is codirector in every detail of its management. The Spirit ever acknowledges the Son as ruler, and the Son always accords the Spirit a co-ordinate position and equality of authority.

p033.s3.b1.q: Such a Divine Minister is in reality the mother of spirits and spirit personalities, the ever-present and all-wise adviser of the Creator Son, a faithful and true manifestation of the Paradise Infinite Spirit.

p033.s3.b3: At the jubilee of jubilees, when the Son is enthroned as a Master Son after his seventh bestowal, the Universe Spirit for the first time publicly acknowledges her subordination to him. Michael then acknowledges his eternal dependence on her, makes her coruler of his domains, and requires all creatures to pledge loyalty to the Spirit as they had to the Son. Then goes forth the “⟦Q 33:3.6⟧Proclamation of Equality⟦/Q⟧,” declaring her equal to him in all endowments of personality and attributes of divine character.

p033.s3.b4.q: This is, in deed and in truth, the high ideal of the family and the human institution of voluntary marriage.

p033.s3.b5: In this scene one partner lays down authority and the other shares it, and each honors the other; it becomes a pattern for the family and for every community. When a free act of subordination is matched by a proclamation of equality, order and equality do not collide.
p033.s4.b0: The Bright and Morning Star is the personalization of the first concept of identity conceived together by the Son and the Spirit, and only one such being is brought forth in each local universe. Gabriel of Salvington is like the Universe Son in divinity of nature, though considerably limited in the attributes of Deity, and he does not share in creative prerogatives. He embraces the will of the Son combined with the creative imagination of the Spirit, and he understands both the seraphic hosts and material mortals.

p033.s4.b2: Gabriel and his staff were never known to leave their regular work except when Michael was incarnated on a bestowal, and at those times Gabriel was ever attendant on the will of the incarnated Son. Mortals seldom meet him except at resurrection roll calls, but anyone who becomes an administrator, of whatever order, comes under his direction.

p033.s4.b3.q: Gabriel and his staff are not teachers; they are administrators.

p033.s5.h: V–VI. The Trinity Ambassadors; General Administration
p033.s5.b0: Local universes are marked by dual supervision, father and mother, yet personalities from Paradise are present too. At their head is the ambassador of the Paradise Trinity, the Union of Days known as Immanuel of Salvington. He is not subject to the local universe government and gives counsel only on request.

p033.s5.b1.q: He bears the distinction of being the only personality in all Nebadon who has never acknowledged subordination to his brother Michael.

p033.s5.b2: His liaison brethren, the Faithfuls of Days, serve on the constellation headquarters, and they too never offer advice unless it is asked for. They are the final personal presence of the Stationary Sons of the Trinity serving in advisory roles in the local universes. Below them, the local systems are administered exclusively by personalities native to the local universe.
p033.s5.b3: Each level of administration has its own concerns. System governments attend especially to the physical and biologic status of living beings; constellation governments to social and governmental conditions, unification, and stabilization; the universe rulers to the spiritual status of the realms. Universe broadcasts reach every inhabited world whatever its spiritual status, but planetary intercommunication is denied to worlds under spiritual quarantine.

p033.s5.b5: Representation within and between universes is also arranged. Ambassadors are appointed by judicial decree to represent this universe to other universes; consuls are appointed by legislative decree to represent constellations; observers are commissioned by executive decree of a System Sovereign to represent their system. Because responsibility is spread so evenly, Michael’s absence in no way interferes with the orderly conduct of universe affairs.
p033.s6.h: VII–VIII. The Courts of Nebadon; The Legislative and Executive Functions
p033.s6.b0: Michael is supremely concerned with only three things, creation, sustenance, and ministry, and he takes no personal part in judicial work. Judging belongs to creatures of high training and actual creature experience. The high courts of Salvington function in seventy branches, and every case is heard by a dual magistracy: one judge of perfection antecedents and one magistrate of ascendant experience.

p033.s6.b3: Authority is divided by level. Salvington has no true legislative bodies and is concerned largely with adjudication; the legislative assemblies sit on the headquarters of the one hundred constellations; the systems handle executive and administrative work. The high advisory councils of Salvington are in reality superlegislatures, yet they only recommend, without authority of enactment or power of execution.
p033.s6.b4: The supreme council on Salvington is made up of three members from each system and seven representatives from each constellation; systems in isolation have no representation and may send only observers. The paper also cautions that “courts” and “assemblies” in the universe are very different from the more primitive and material institutions of Urantia that bear the same names.

p033.s6.b6.q: You are living in a well-ordered universe, and sooner or later you may depend upon being dealt with justly, even mercifully.

p033.s7.b0: Paper 33 can look like an organizational chart, but personal relationships run beneath it. The Creator does not judge his creatures, the sovereign proclaims his companion’s equality, and the highest ambassador counsels only when asked. Even when we suffer unfair judgments on earth, the paper assures us that the universe stands on an order in which justice and mercy prevail.

p034.lead: The Mother Spirit who stands beside the Creator Son, the three spirit circuits and seven adjutants, and the struggle of spirit and flesh within us.

p034.foot.text: Presented by a Mighty Messenger temporarily assigned to service on Urantia

p034.s0.h: Introduction — The One Beside the Son
p034.s0.b0: Paper 33 introduced Michael and his government; Paper 34 turns to the one who works beside him as his equal, the **local universe Mother Spirit**. When a Creator Son is personalized, the Infinite Spirit individualizes a new and unique representation of himself to go with that Son into space. She becomes the Son’s companion, first in physical organization and later in creating and ministering to the creatures of the new universe.
p034.s0.b1: Because both respond to physical and to spiritual realities, they work together as co-ordinate associates. In physical creation the Son provides the pattern, and the Spirit initiates the actual materialization of physical realities. The Son designs; the Spirit shapes the design into substance.
p034.s1.h: I. Personalization of the Creative Spirit — The Primary Eruption
p034.s1.b0: When the physical organization is complete, Michael proclaims that life is next to be projected in the new universe. Upon Paradise recognition there is a reaction of approval in the Trinity, and the Master Spirit of that superuniverse disappears into the spiritual shining of the Deities and then reappears. At that moment comes the “primary eruption,” a tremendous spiritual flash visible as far away as the superuniverse headquarters, and in the very presence of the Creator Son a new personal representation of the Infinite Spirit is personalized.

p034.s1.b2: The author admits that the secret of this process resides in the bosom of the Trinity. Only one thing is certain: during physical organization the Spirit presence was incompletely differentiated from the Infinite Spirit, but after the eruption it changes completely into a personal being tinged with the nature of that superuniverse’s Master Spirit. It is through this personalization that the Spirit could later become fully subject to the Son.

p034.s1.b3.q: They are instantaneous, inscrutable, and incomprehensible

p034.s2.h: II. Nature of the Divine Minister — The Breath of Life
p034.s2.b0: After Michael is elevated to Master Son, the Mother Spirit becomes so augmented in personal qualities that all who contact her recognize her as a person. From the beginning she possesses the physical-control attributes of the Infinite Spirit, including antigravity, and on attaining personal status she exerts full control of mind gravity in the local universe. Her techniques vary according to the Master Spirit through whom she originated, yet in all essential spiritual attributes every Universe Spirit is identical.
p034.s2.b1: Life is ministered and maintained through the Creative Spirit. In creating intelligent beings she first collaborates with the Son to produce the Bright and Morning Star, and her later offspring come ever closer to the beings of the planets. For mortals, the Life Carriers provide the body and the Universe Spirit adds the breath of life.

p034.s2.b2.q: Life is ministered and maintained through the agency of the Creative Spirit.

p034.s2.b3.q: the Life Carrier Sons provide the physical body, fabricated out of the existing organized material of the realm, while the Universe Spirit contributes the “breath of life.”

p034.s2.b4: The presiding Spirit of our superuniverse, Orvonton, is the chief of the Master Spirits, embodying the balanced union of the traits of all three Deities. So although Orvonton now seems tardy and backward, it is expected to evolve into an extraordinarily well-balanced creation. A slow start is no proof of inferiority, and the same holds true of personal growth.
p034.s3.h: III. The Son and Spirit in Time and Space — Partners Who Fill Each Other’s Limits
p034.s3.b0: Only absolute beings are independent of time and space in the absolute sense. The Creative Spirit is wholly independent of space and is just as personally present on one world of her universe as on any other, but in her ministry of the universal mind she must reckon with time. The Creator Son, by contrast, is not handicapped by time, but he cannot personally be in two places at once.

p034.s3.b2: When the Son and the Spirit function in administrative union, each always has available the liberation of the other, and so within their creation they are practically independent of both time and space. This partnership, in which each makes up for the other’s limits, shows why true co-operation is more than a mere division of labor.

p034.s3.b3.q: One is free to choose and act only within the realm of one’s consciousness.

p034.s4.b1: The Spirit of Truth derives from the personality of the Son but is functionally centered in the person of the Mother Spirit. She never leaves the headquarters world, and it is precisely her fixed presence that lets the Spirit of Truth work undisturbed wherever the Son may be. She is the universe focus of both the Holy Spirit and the Spirit of Truth.

p034.s4.b2.q: The Universe Mother Spirit, however, never leaves the local universe headquarters world.

p034.s4.b4: The seven adjutants are the creation of the Divine Minister; similar in character but diverse in power, they are hardly regarded as personalities apart from their Mother Creator. The paper explains John’s vision of the “⟦Q 34:4.11⟧seven spirits of God,⟦/Q⟧” the four beasts, and the twenty-four elders as a blend of two scenes, one at Salvington and one at Jerusem. It adds that all living creatures have bodily units responsive to directional currents, so that the sense of orientation is fixed in life itself.
p034.s4.b5: Mind is also endowed differently at different levels. Superevolutionary personalities receive the local universe type of the superuniverse pattern of mind, while human and subhuman life receive the adjutant type of mind ministry. The paper notes as well that the Creative Spirit does not bestow mind until she is endowed with personal prerogatives.
p034.s5.h: V. The Ministry of the Spirit — The Threshold of Worship and Wisdom
p034.s5.b0: On the inhabited worlds the Spirit leads the evolution of life from lifeless matter to plants, animals, and the first human orders, working chiefly through the seven adjutants. When animal mind develops capacity to receive the adjutants of worship and wisdom, its evolution crosses the threshold of spiritual ministry, and such a mind is at once included in the circuits of the Holy Spirit.
p034.s5.b1: A mind ministered to by the Holy Spirit has the capacity to choose a Thought Adjuster, yet not until a bestowal Son has released the Spirit of Truth are all normal minds automatically prepared to receive Adjusters. The Spirit of Truth depends almost wholly on man’s personal reception, while the Holy Spirit is only partly conditioned by human attitude.

p034.s6.h: VI. The Spirit in Man — The Spirit That Leads but Never Drives
p034.s6.b0: Divinity may be plural in manifestation, but in human experience all spirit influences are one in function. The divine Spirit descends by a long series of steps to meet us as we are and where we are, and it does not stop until it has lifted the soul back to the heights from which it first came forth.
p034.s6.b1: Spiritual life, like physical energy, is consumed; spiritual effort brings relative exhaustion. That is why we need daily renewal. And even the highest doctrine, as dead theory, cannot change character. The Spirit must breathe upon the forms of truth.

p034.s6.b2.q: unless and until the divine Spirit breathes upon the forms of truth and quickens the formulas of righteousness.

p034.s6.b3.q: The Spirit never drives, only leads.

p034.s6.b4: When we freely accept the Spirit’s guidance, the assurance of divine contact grows and the fruits of the spirit show in our lives. The words that the Spirit bears witness “with” our spirit point to the fact that the Adjuster has already told us of our kinship with God.

p034.s6.b5.q: the fruits of the spirit are love, joy, peace, long-suffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, and temperance.

p034.s7.h: VII. The Spirit and the Flesh — Urantia’s Double Deprivation
p034.s7.b0: Mortals on normal worlds do not suffer an unceasing war between flesh and spirit; for them, rising from the animal level to the spiritual is more like an educational training. There is a reason why the conflict on Urantia is so acute.

p034.s7.b1.q: The mortals of a normal world do not experience constant warfare between their physical and spiritual natures.

p034.s7.b3: Yet there is comfort. Those born of the Spirit experience no more conflict than the inhabitants of the most normal worlds, and the natural appetites of the body are not in conflict with the highest spiritual attainment except in the minds of the ignorant, the mistaught, or the overconscientious. It is a balanced teaching: hostility to the body is not spirituality.

p034.s7.b4.q: the Spirit of Truth will always speak, saying, “This is the way.”

p034.s8.b0: Paper 34 explains one pillar of universe administration, yet it ends by bringing us back to our own inner life. The Mother Spirit who gave the breath of life, the Son’s spirit that leads us into truth, and the Father’s Adjuster dwelling deep in the mind all work as one within a single person. Because that Spirit never coerces, a willingness to learn is the key to growth.

p035.lead: Melchizedeks, Vorondadeks, and Lanonandeks: the nature, work, and worlds of the Sons born of the Creator Son and the Mother Spirit.

p035.foot.text: Sponsored by the Chief of Archangels acting by authority of Gabriel of Salvington

p035.s0.h: Introduction — From Paradise Sons to Local Universe Sons
p035.s0.b0: The Sons of God introduced in earlier papers were of Paradise origin. Nebadon has one Creator Son, Michael; its full quota of 1,062 Avonal or Magisterial Sons; and, by the author’s estimate, between fifteen and twenty thousand Trinity Teacher Sons. Paper 35 now turns to the Sons born in the local universe itself, the offspring of the Creator Son in varied association with the Universe Mother Spirit.

p035.s0.b2: The pattern shows that what happens above is repeated below. Just as Paradise Deity brings forth three orders of Sons, so the Son and the Spirit of the local universe bring forth three orders of their own. This paper introduces each in turn and leads us through the worlds of the Salvington circuit where each order teaches ascending mortals.
p035.s1.h: I–II. The Father Melchizedek; The Melchizedek Sons — The Eldest Sons of the Universe
p035.s1.b0: After administrative personalities such as Gabriel come into being, a new creative union of the Son and the Spirit produces the original Melchizedek, the Father Melchizedek, who then collaborates with them to bring into existence the whole group bearing that name. He is Gabriel’s first executive associate: Gabriel is occupied more with policies, Melchizedek with practical procedures and the emergency commissions. The two are never away from Salvington at the same time.
p035.s1.b1: The Melchizedeks are the first order of divine Sons to draw near enough to lower creature life to serve the evolutionary races without incarnation. Standing about midway between the highest Divinity and the lowest will creatures, they are natural intermediaries. All intelligent life finds in them understanding friends, sympathetic teachers, and wise counselors.

p035.s1.b2.q: The seraphic orders, the angels, delight to work with the Melchizedeks

p035.s1.b3.q: not once throughout all the superuniverse of Orvonton have these Melchizedek Sons ever betrayed their trust.

p035.s1.b4: They are the pattern of self-government. Like the eldest son in a large family they take on much work of their own accord, patrol their native universe on their own initiative, and report to the Creator Son independently of the regular channels. Yet they are not infallible. Alone on planetary missions they have sometimes erred in minor matters; then they receive instruction on Salvington and return to service on the third day.

p035.s1.b5.q: The Melchizedeks are well-nigh perfect in wisdom, but they are not infallible in judgment.

p035.s2.h: III–IV. The Melchizedek Worlds; Special Work of the Melchizedeks
p035.s2.b0: The seventy primary spheres of the Salvington circuit, each with six tributaries, make 490 worlds known together as the Melchizedek University. The first group of seven is supervised by the Melchizedeks, and every evolutionary mortal who graduates from constellation training lands on the pilot world Melchizedek to begin the Salvington educational regime. The author says this is probably the most interesting place in all Nebadon for an ascender.

p035.s2.b1.q: And never will you forget your reactions to the first day of life on this unique world, not even after you have reached your Paradise destination.

p035.s2.b3: This method of reviewing and co-ordinating the life already lived, before stepping into a new stage, is striking. Experience does not become wisdom merely by piling up; it becomes a foundation for the next step only when we look back and connect its parts. Though Nebadon stands low in spiritual achievement, its administrative troubles have made it a vast clinic for nearby creations, so that more than one hundred thousand foreign students always attend the Melchizedek schools.
p035.s2.b4: The pilot world holds the schools of universe administration and spiritual wisdom, along with schools devoted to single lines of research such as energy, matter, organization, communication, records, and ethics. In the Melchizedek College of Spiritual Endowment, all orders of Sons, even the Paradise orders, join Melchizedek and seraphic teachers in training evangels who proclaim spiritual liberty and divine sonship to distant worlds. The highest course in administration, the College of High Ethics, is presided over by the Father Melchizedek himself.
p035.s2.b5: Melchizedeks act first in every emergency; on Edentia they are called the emergency Sons. Seven times in Nebadon one of them has served in the likeness of mortal flesh, and one such was the Prince of Salem in Abraham’s day on Urantia. Fearing that the light of life would be extinguished in a time of growing spiritual darkness, the planetary receivers approved his incarnation, and he passed the truth on to Abraham and his associates.

p035.s2.b6.q: Whenever and wherever special help is needed, there you will find one or more of the Melchizedek Sons.

p035.s3.h: V–VII. The Vorondadek Sons; The Constellation Fathers; The Vorondadek Worlds
p035.s3.b0: The second order, the Vorondadeks, are better known as Constellation Fathers, since one of them heads each constellation government. Nebadon has one million of them, and their number does not increase. They lack the brilliant versatility of the Melchizedeks but are even more reliable as rulers and administrators, and they excel all orders of sonship in stability of purpose and divinity of judgment.

p035.s3.b1.q: never in all the history of Nebadon has a Vorondadek been found in contempt of the universe government.

p035.s3.b2: They serve as ambassadors to other universes, as consuls representing constellations, and as Most High observers on isolated worlds; as a result of all this service they have become the historians of the local universes. At least three Vorondadeks are assigned to each constellation, and the one hundred Constellation Fathers form the supreme advisory cabinet of the Creator Son.

p035.s3.b4.q: No major policy, however, is ever carried out in a constellation unless all three of the Most Highs are agreed upon all the details of its execution.

p035.s3.b5: The principle that no major policy goes forward unless all three Most Highs agree on every detail shows that the higher the authority, the more it is exercised through agreement. On the forty-nine Vorondadek worlds, ascenders take part in enacting the actual general legislation of the local universe under the tutelage of the senior Vorondadeks.
p035.s3.b6: The author admits that while revealing the new activities ascenders will meet on the Vorondadek worlds is not forbidden, there are no words to convey them to the material mind and no human occupations to serve as illustrations. Such moments, where revelation halts at the limits of language, honestly tell us that the ascending life ahead exceeds anything we can now imagine.
p035.s4.h: VIII–IX. The Lanonandek Sons; The Lanonandek Rulers — The Risks and Rewards of Freedom
p035.s4.b0: The third order, the Lanonandeks, are best known as System Sovereigns and Planetary Princes. Being lower in divinity level, they were the first students of the Melchizedek University. Nebadon began with exactly twelve million Lanonandeks, and once divided into three classes in their final tests, they cannot advance from one class to another.
p035.s4.b1: System Sovereigns rule in commissions of two or three on each system headquarters, and the Constellation Father names one of them chief every dekamillennium. System governments do not suddenly change personnel unless some tragedy occurs, and when a sovereign is recalled, the constellation’s supreme council fills the place from the reserves.

p035.s4.b3: Because Lanonandeks can draw nearer to the lower creatures, they render greater service, but they also stand in greater danger of going astray. A System Sovereign is well-nigh sovereign in local affairs and is not supervised by Trinity observers, so that office is the one place where disloyalty to Michael’s will could most easily entrench itself. Over seven hundred Lanonandeks in Nebadon have rebelled, and only three of them were System Sovereigns.
p035.s4.b4: The author insists this is no fault in creatorship. They could have been made perfect, but were created as they are so as to understand evolutionary creatures better. Freedom of choice causes great trouble in early ages, yet the high rulers hold that the greater loyalty of thoroughly tested Sons will more than compensate for that confusion.

p035.s4.b5.q: They could have been made divinely perfect, but they were so created that they might better understand, and draw near to, the evolutionary creatures dwelling on the worlds of time and space.

p035.s4.b6.q: Only a bestowal Son can re-establish interplanetary lines of communication on such a spiritually isolated world.

p035.s4.b7: There is a plan of salvage even for the wayward Sons, and many have accepted it. Yet they never again serve in the positions in which they defaulted; after rehabilitation they are assigned to custodial duties and physical administration.
p035.s5.h: X. The Lanonandek Worlds — A School Where We Practice What We Learn
p035.s5.b0: On the third group of seven worlds in the Salvington circuit, former System Sovereigns serve as administrative teachers of ascenders and seraphim. Here ascenders take part in actually co-ordinating the administrative pronouncements of the ten thousand local systems. Most of the salvaged Lanonandeks also serve in connection with these worlds as custodians of planetary affairs.

p035.s5.b1.q: The universe educational system sponsored by the Melchizedeks is practical, progressive, meaningful, and experiential.

p035.s5.b2: The paper’s final words are fair-minded. Many Lanonandeks in the older systems have set wonderful records of service and spiritual achievement; despite their tendency to err through fallacies of personal liberty, they are a noble, faithful, and loyal group.
p035.s6.b0: The three orders of Sons in Paper 35 each display a different virtue. The Melchizedeks show willing service and trustworthiness; the Vorondadeks, steady judgment and agreement; the Lanonandeks, the risks of freedom and the worth of loyalty that has stood the test. And since every one of these Sons appears as a teacher of ascenders, universe administration turns out to be a system of education as well.

p035.s6.b2: The next paper, Paper 36, takes up the fourth order of local universe Sons that this paper set aside: the Life Carriers, who plant life on the planets.
p036.lead: The Life Carriers who design life and plant it on the planets, the mystery of the midsoniters, the seven adjutant mind-spirits, and where the spark of life comes from.

p036.foot.text: Indited by a Vorondadek Son stationed on Urantia as an observer, acting by request of the Melchizedek Chief of the Supervising Revelatory Corps

p036.s0.h: Introduction — Life Does Not Arise by Itself
p036.s0.b0: The fourth order of Sons that Paper 35 set aside is the subject of this paper. Its first sentence is plain: life is constructed according to plans formulated by unrevealed Architects of Being, and it appears on the planets either by direct importation or through the work of the Life Carriers. The Life Carriers design life, carry it to the worlds, and stay on for long ages after planting it to foster its development.
p036.s1.h: I. Origin and Nature of Life Carriers
p036.s1.b0: The Life Carriers are the only group of intelligent life in a local universe in whose creation the rulers of a superuniverse take part. Their parents are the Creator Son, the Mother Spirit, and one of the Ancients of Days of the superuniverse. It is fitting that those who alone can decree the extinction of intelligent life should share in creating the beings who establish life.

p036.s1.b2: The three divisions were sorted out by tests the Melchizedeks conducted, and ever since, the Melchizedeks have been closely associated with the Life Carriers, always going with them when they establish life on a new planet. The Life Carriers are not a truly self-governing group, but they govern themselves in the administration of their own divisions.
p036.s2.h: II. The Life Carrier Worlds — Seven Spheres for the Study of Life
p036.s2.b0: The fourth group of seven worlds in the Salvington circuit belongs to the Life Carriers and is under the general oversight of the Melchizedeks. Each primary sphere is surrounded by six satellites, and on the first world are the central emplacements of the seven adjutant mind-spirits.

p036.s2.b2: The original life designs are provided by the Creator Son, but their outworking is entrusted to the Life Carriers, and any plan that departs from accepted formulas must be endorsed by the Creator Son. Because the Life Carriers constantly work to improve the vital formulas, life is never exactly the same on any two planets, even within one family of worlds.
p036.s2.b3: One fact about Urantia stands out. Urantia is a decimal planet, a life-experiment world: on one world in ten a greater variance from the standard life designs is permitted, and the life now evolving on Urantia was planned and partly worked out in the laboratories of the second world. The domain of life is marked by three, seven, and twelve and their multiples, and the human sex cells on Urantia carry forty-eight trait determiners.
p036.s2.b4: The studies of the third world lead to the early establishment of a life-conservation commission on each new world. Urantia had twenty-four custodian commissioners, two for each parent pattern of life material. The paper adds that on such planets the highest form of life is reproduced by a bundle of twenty-four pattern units, and on that physical foundation arise the twenty-four basic orders of psychic organization.
p036.s2.b5: The research of the fourth world explains the apparent waste of evolution. Because the original life plasm must hold the potential for every future variation, many seemingly useless forms of plant and animal life may appear and vanish. Yet through the whole long process runs the thread of the designers’ wisdom, and those by-products are all essential to the full function of the higher intelligent life.
p036.s3.h: III. Life Transplantation — Hands Off When Will Appears
p036.s3.b0: A corps commissioned to plant life usually consists of one hundred senior carriers, one hundred assistants, and one thousand custodians. Sometimes they bring life plasm with them; sometimes, as on Urantia, they organize the life patterns after arriving, according to approved formulas. Then they catalyze the lifeless material, imparting the vital spirit spark, and the inert patterns become living matter.

p036.s3.b1.q: The vital spark—the mystery of life—is bestowed through the Life Carriers, not by them.

p036.s3.b3: The principle that even the designers of life must withdraw the moment a being with power of moral decision appears shows how deeply human freedom is respected. From then on, evolution proceeds according to the nature and tendencies already planted in the patterns. Two senior carriers who volunteered to remain, with their twelve associates, are now serving on Urantia.

p036.s3.b4.q: The Life Carriers are not permitted to experiment or to interfere with will

p036.s4.h: IV. Melchizedek Life Carriers — The Mystery of the Midsoniters
p036.s4.b0: Each local system has a single sphere, the midsonite world, on which a Melchizedek has served as life carrier. There a materially modified Melchizedek Son mates with a Mother Eve chosen from the Material Daughters, and their offspring are the midsoniters. These beings reproduce until they are one thousand standard years old; then they are translated by seraphic transport and never reproduce again.
p036.s4.b2: Without indwelling Adjusters they are hardly immortal, yet they do not seem mortal either. Every midsoniter ever born in Nebadon is still alive, on its native world, on some intervening sphere, or on the Salvington midsonite sphere, the seventh of the finaliters’ worlds, where they seem to be gathering for some future eventuality. Their purpose is unknown, and the finaliters always decline to discuss their destiny. Passages like this, where the author honestly admits what he does not know, show that this revelation does not pretend to know everything.
p036.s5.h: V. The Seven Adjutant Mind-Spirits — Why Evolution Is Not Accidental
p036.s5.b0: What conditions organic evolution on the primitive worlds is the presence of the seven adjutant mind-spirits, and this is why evolution is purposeful rather than accidental. The adjutants are the children of the Mother Spirit and her personal ministry to material minds. Yet they are not separate personalities; they are more like circuits, in fact a level of consciousness of the Mother Spirit herself.
p036.s5.b1: Their central emplacements on the Life Carrier headquarters world indicate the mind function of the adjutants on any world and in any organism. The first five are measured there perfectly, but for worship and wisdom only a qualitative function is recorded; their quantitative activity is registered as the personal experience of the Mother Spirit on Salvington. In other words, the two highest functions of mind are reckoned not in numbers but in the Mother Spirit’s own experience.

p036.s5.b3.q: Worship is the badge of spiritual-ascension candidacy.

p036.s5.b4: The levels of mind fall into three. Before the capacity to learn from experience appears, mind is the domain of the Master Physical Controllers; before it can recognize and worship Deity, it is the exclusive domain of the adjutants. When spiritual response appears, the mind becomes supermind at once and enters the spirit circuits of the Mother Spirit. The paper also notes that animals are in some measure indispensable to man’s intellectual as well as physical evolution.

p036.s5.b5.q: Mind is a divinity bestowal, but it is not immortal when it functions without spirit insight, and when it is devoid of the ability to worship and crave survival.

p036.s6.h: VI. Living Forces — Life Only from Life
p036.s6.b0: Life is both mechanistic and vitalistic. Physicists and chemists will go on understanding protoplasm better, but they will never produce living organisms. Even the experimental life the Life Carriers organize on Salvington lacks mind and the power of reproduction. Mind is the Mother Spirit’s gift through the adjutants, and reproductive ability is likewise her personal impartation.

p036.s6.b1.q: Things material may enjoy an independent existence, but life springs only from life.

p036.s6.b3: We often speak of life as energy or force, but according to this paper it is really neither. Force-energy responds to gravity; life does not. Life is the animation of a pattern-configured system of energy, whether material, mindal, or spiritual.
p036.s6.b4: At death the life of plants and animals survives only as part of the cosmic forces, without identity; it does not survive individually. The survival of mortal creatures depends wholly on the evolution of an immortal soul within the mortal mind. The author admits he does not fully understand the nature and source of the life-activating spark, and sums up briefly what is known.

p036.s6.b5.q: simply that concept is inherent in the Father, expression in the Son, and life realization in the Spirit.

p036.s7.b0: Paper 36 shows that life is not the product of chance but the fruit of design, care, and a divine spark. Yet even the designers of life step back the moment will appears. The seven adjutants within us grow the mind from instinct to wisdom, but for that mind to reach immortality it must choose to worship and to crave survival.
